**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.  E.g. "I'm always
frustrated when [...]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other approaches or workarounds you've thought about.

**Which area does this affect?**
- [ ] Server / SpacetimeDB module (Rust)
- [ ] Python SDK / Client
- [ ] CLI (`stmem`)
- [ ] Drop-in adapter (mem0, zep, honcho, graphiti, etc.)
- [ ] Docs / website
- [ ] CI / build tooling
- [ ] Other (please describe)

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
